title: Shift-loop instruction by phase
statement: For a natural number $K_0$, given a register $r$ among $0$ through $16$, an exit label, a function assigning a label to each of the nine shift-loop phases, and a phase $j\in\{0,\ldots,8\}$, define the instruction as follows: phase $0$ tests whether register $13$ is zero, branching to the exit if so and phase $1$ otherwise; phase $1$ decrements register $13$ and proceeds to phase $2; phase $2$ tests whether $r$ is zero, branching to phase $6$ if so and phase $3$ otherwise; phase $3$ decrements $r$ and proceeds to phase $4$; phases $4$ and $5$ each increment register $0$, proceeding respectively to phase $5$ and back to phase $2$; phase $6$ tests whether register $0$ is zero, branching to phase $0$ if so and phase $7$ otherwise; phase $7$ decrements register $0$ and proceeds to phase $8; and phase $8$ increments $r$ and returns to phase $6$.
hypotheses_covered: Label assigned to each of nine phases
